author: Unknown
pages:
whoever finds this

do not go down the lower stair. we thought the dead stayed dead. they DO NOT. Eirik opened the big coffin with the bronze lid and it SAT UP

we ran. they followed. they do not tire. they do not stop.

I am hiding in the side chamber with the urns. I can hear them scraping along the hall. they speak in a language I do not know but it hurts to hear.

if you are reading this turn back. or if you must go on, bring fire, bring silver, bring friends

tell my mother I am sorry about the sheep
